title: Cambodian Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Cambodian Civil War", at revision 1375075951, opens: "The Cambodian Civil War was a civil war in Cambodia fought between the Khmer Rouge against the government of the Kingdom of Cambodia. Following the March 1970 coup, the conflict shifted as the Khmer Rouge and forces loyal to Norodom Sihanouk, now supported by North Vietnam and China, fought against the Khmer Republic, which was supported by the United States and South Vietnam." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q817206, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "civil war in Cambodia between 1967 and 1975". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
